json.answer: Gemini 3.8 Flash was released on September 1, 2026. It is designed for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows, delivering substantial improvements over the 3.7 Flash model.

The Gemini API release notes from September 22, 2026 announced the general availability (GA) of Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS, along with the new Gemini API Voices endpoint. Additionally, updates for Gemini 3.8 Flash include updating the model ID to gemini-3.8-flash, removing deprecated sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, top_k), replacing thinking_budget with the string enum thinking_level, and removing candidate_count.

Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026, featuring major improvements in software engineering, agentic workflows, and multi-step reasoning over 3.7 Flash. It is available at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, with subsequent general availability and Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS released on September 23, 2026.

Gemini 3.8 Flash was released as generally available (GA) as the model gemini-3.8-flash. It is Google's most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.
